sprint: Cross-Origin Canvas Tainting — the Real Root Cause of the Video-Reported Freeze
task: A fifth, decisive pass on the same reported bug after four prior real fixes (ThumbnailEngine clobber, Selection Action Strip repaint, artworkTheme persistence, Change Look canvas-orphaning) were each shipped and rejected as not matching what the user experiences. The user's own live diagnostic run on their real 'Forest Sync - cloud 1.2' project threw 'Uncaught SecurityError: Failed to execute toDataURL on HTMLCanvasElement: Tainted canvases may not be exported' -- the first genuinely new evidence -- followed by independent confirmation the same freeze reproduces on a second, freshly-authored theme after adding an image background and a text Experience, ruling out project-specific corruption. Root cause: AssetStore.resolve()'s signed-URL fallback tier can return a genuinely cross-origin Supabase Storage URL, and none of the three Image() constructions consuming it (projectManager.js's loadImageFromDataURL, slideRenderer.js's _ensureDecorationImage, pictureStudio.js's open()) ever set img.crossOrigin before assigning .src -- silently tainting any canvas the image is drawn onto with zero visible error until a later toDataURL()/getImageData() call throws. ThumbnailEngine.generate() taints its own throwaway temp/thumbCanvas this way and throws on its own encode step; because tainting also propagates to #previewCanvas the moment the same image is drawn there via redrawPreview(), the visible canvas stops updating on further edits even though tainting alone doesn't normally block drawing -- confirmed via a decisive screenshot-based (not getImageData-based, which throws identically whether tainted-but-drawing or genuinely frozen) git-stash A/B Playwright reproduction: on the unmodified baseline the canvas region's screenshot hash stayed byte-identical before and after a real content edit even though the model correctly updated, while the fixed code showed the hash genuinely change. Fixed by adding img.crossOrigin='anonymous' to all three Image() construction sites, matching Supabase Storage's own real, permissive CORS default. Full regression across 9 directly-relevant existing scratch suites passed unchanged; a second batch of 6 scripts failed identically on both the fixed and unmodified baseline (confirmed via git stash to be pre-existing, unrelated staleness -- a stale Traveller-Gateway-skip helper and the already-documented sticker-drag bug). Both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2, 30/30 each) pass unchanged. This is the first fix in the whole investigation that reproduces the reported symptom on demand on the unmodified baseline via a technique immune to the bug's own tainting side effects -- the strongest evidence obtained so far -- but per established discipline should be considered fully resolved only once the user verifies it against their own real project. Confined to js/projectManager.js, renderer/slideRenderer.js, js/pictureStudio.js, and js/thumbnails.js.
